en: Color illustration of an old European building with arched arcades at street level and richly painted façades depicting animals, horses, and human figures. The upper stories have green wooden shutters and small wrought‑iron balconies. On the left is the rounded apse and dome of an adjacent church. A small fountain with a statue stands in front of the arcades, and a few people are visible in the square. The card has no visible caption or writing on the image side.
